entries.name: Flamedramon
entries.description: Flamedramon is a bipedal creature with blue skin that looks like a grown version of Veemon . It wears armor on its face, chest, thighs, hands, and feet, It has a blade-like spike protruding from its mask and claws from its hands. The armor is covered with flame-like designs. The forehead spike and the armor's flame design are references to the Digi-Egg of Courage , with which it is intimately associated. It wears belts on its upper arms. Official romanization given by the Digimon Reference Book and used in Japanese media. Name used in the American English dub of Digimon Adventure 02 and in American English media.

entries.name: Menoa Bellucci
entries.description: Menoa is a young woman with fair skin, blue eyes, and shoulder-length brown hair, which she wears in a braided ponytail. She ties her braid with a Morpho -shaped hairpin. She wears a collared white shirt with short sleeves, a black pencil skirt, and red sneakers.

entries.name: Gravimon (Fusion)
entries.description: Gravimon is both a sadistic leader and a tactical genius, able to see through Mikey's strategies and surreptitiously use his sole weakness, his core, to turn Christopher into his hostage. His defeat only comes about when, in a moment of hubris, he doesn't consider the possibility that Mikey would sacrifice himself for his friends.

entries.name: Tachibana and Sakurada
entries.description: Tachibana ( タチバナ , Tachibana ? ) and Sakurada ( サクラダ , Sakurada ? ) are both members of the DigiPolice . They are each partnered to Commandramon and are able to Mindlink , meaning they also have Digimon Linkers . Satsuki Tamahime trained them, and considers them to be her aces.

entries.name: Golemon
entries.description: Golemon is a bipedal creature made of yellow rock, with its limbs and joints bound by white strings. It has red eyes and its arms are very developed and long enough to rest its hands on the ground while standing. It wears a metal mask with a brown belt that covers the upper half of its face. Official romanization given by the Digimon Reference Book and used in Japanese and some American English media. Name used in Digimon World 3 and some American English media.

entries.name: Shawjamon
entries.description: Shawjamon is based on the Kappa with blue hair, wears clothes and carries a weapon which is his Kouyoujou staff. The staff itself has a revolver-like cylinder at one end and a crescent-shaped blade on the other. The clothing is Japanese-style armor with a Gappa or traveling cloak on his back and a headband covering his eyes. Around his neck is a necklace of nine beads that have eyes and stitched up mouths. Official romanization given by the Digimon Reference Book and used in Japanese media. Official name given by the Digimon Encyclopedia and used in most American English.
